sources.title: zils-ai/d3-mini-4.5b-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Zils pins this repository as the base of the d3-mini-4.5b-v1 model profile so that every miner and validator downloads the same files; the profile's pins file records each file's SHA-256 and the vendor revision above. Licence: Apache-2.0 (the vendor's weights, readout and runtime; base model Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B). No weights were changed.
